Features tested: Policy Templates tab with 10 templates, org profile setup/edit, category filter, SIEM thresholds display, policy generation (AI-powered), generated policy viewer with section editing, Upload & Map tab with framework selector and drag-drop zone, Document Library tab with tag document dialog, Control Mappings tab (embedded), Cross-Framework tab (embedded), and URL tab params.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Policy Center redesign complete and verified. 5 tabs: Policy Templates (primary), Upload & Map (primary), Document Library (primary), Control Mappings (secondary), Cross-Framework (secondary). 10 policy templates available with SIEM thresholds. Org profile stored in 'org_profiles' collection. Generated policies stored in 'generated_templates' collection. Document tags stored in 'document_tags' collection.
